_comment: Input paths for theme-roles.mjs. They are DATA, not code — same reason kit-digest.sources.json
gives: the theme pages are still in a session folder and have not been promoted into the kit.
When a theme is promoted, edit its line here; the census and the gate re-point with it, no code
change. ~ expands to $HOME. Explicit --<key>=<path> flags override anything here.
'prefix' is the theme's own namespace prefix, if it has one. It is DATA because a prefix is a
mechanical alias carrying zero role information: --nv-focus and --focus are the same role. The
gate strips it before matching and reports 'prefix-strip owed' rather than pretending the theme
is compliant. A theme with no prefix omits the key.
'frozen' is the byte-copy snapshot the shipped contract in theme-roles.json was MEASURED against
(2026-08-01T20:10, taken because three agents were concurrently rewriting the live files). Run
with --frozen to reproduce the contract's recorded observations exactly. The default run reads
'sources' (live) on purpose: the difference between the two IS the drift signal.
